name: Chasing A-Me 01
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Checking to see if you're prepared to lead A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel, you flip the switch to the "Off" position. Glancing around once again to make sure none of the gorillas are coming, you prepare to see what happens when you flip the switch back to the "On" position.

This is your last chance... are you sure this is what you want to do?
narrative.objectives: Escort A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel in Un'Goro Crater.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Oh, you've done it! Wonderful! Thank you, adventurer.

Oh, my poor, A-Me. Look at all those dents. We'll get her up and running perfectly with just a little work.

Thank you again, adventurer. I really appreciate it.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you been able to help A-Me? That mithril casing you mentioned being destroyed was a good guess at what was wrong. I'm sure if you replace that, she'll reactivate and be able to come home.
narrative.endText: Protect A-Me 01 until you reach Karna Remtravel

chain.subtitle: 3 quests at level 53, 13,150 XP in all.
